entities.summary: David M. Wehner is an American business executive who is the chief strategy officer (CSO) of Meta Platforms. Born in 1967 in Berkeley, California, Wehner graduated from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and began his career at Microsoft. He joined Facebook in 2011 and played a crucial role in its acquisition of Instagram and WhatsApp. Wehner's leadership during the COVID-19 pandemic helped Meta navigate the crisis and solidify its position in the tech industry. As CSO, he oversees the development of strategic initiatives and partnerships, driving the company's growth and innovation. Wehner's expertise in strategy and technology has earned him recognition as one of the top executives in the tech industry. His work has been featured in prominent publications such as Forbes and Bloomberg, cementing his status as a leading figure in the tech world. Wehner's legacy extends beyond his professional achievements, as he has been a vocal advocate for diversity and inclusion in the tech industry. His efforts have inspired a new generation of leaders and entrepreneurs, ensuring that his impact will be felt for years to come.
